# skycloak_realm_export (Resource)

A one-shot export of a single realm (configuration, users, and credentials). Creating the resource starts the export and waits for it to finish. The archive is always encrypted and Skycloak deletes it 24 hours after completion, so `download_url` becomes null once `expires_at` has passed — recreate the resource to produce a fresh export.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm_export" "customer_portal" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm      = skycloak_realm.customer_portal.name

  # Always required: a realm export contains credentials, so the archive is
  # always encrypted.
  encryption_password = var.realm_export_password
}

output "realm_export_download_url" {
  # Presigned and short-lived: Skycloak deletes the archive 24h after the export
  # completes, after which this is null.
  value     = skycloak_realm_export.customer_portal.download_url
  sensitive = true
}

output "realm_export_source_version" {
  # An import target must run this Keycloak version or newer.
  value = skycloak_realm_export.customer_portal.source_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `encryption_password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to encrypt the archive (AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2), 8-128 characters. Required: every realm export contains credentials. Write-only; never read back, so an imported resource plans a replacement until it is set. Immutable.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm to export. Immutable.

### Optional

- `scope` (String) Export scope. Only `full` is currently supported. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String) Completion timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `download_url` (String, Sensitive) Time-limited presigned download URL. Null once the archive has expired.
- `expires_at` (String) When the archive is deleted from storage, 24h after completion (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Realm export job ID.
- `progress` (Number) Completion percentage (0-100).
- `sha256_checksum` (String) SHA-256 checksum of the encrypted archive (hex).
- `source_version` (String) Keycloak version that produced the export. An import target must run this version or newer.
- `status` (String) Job status (`pending`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`).
